reason: The money is not the problem, ₹999 a month is nothing for my salon. But I have never heard of this company and no owner I know or my distributor uses it, so I am not putting my staff and customer data on it just because an ad says so.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, and my stylists will not like checking in with a selfie and being watched on every bill. I already lost two good stylists, I don't want to push more out over some app nobody I know has tried.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon owner I know, or my product distributor, using it for a few months and telling me it actually stopped cash leakage without staff complaining.
